en.topic_title: Japan emperor declares Asian Games open following turbulent build-up
en.topic_summary:
The 20th Asian Games were declared open by Japan’s emperor on Saturday following a troubled build-up to the multi-sport spectacular that has more athletes than the Olympics.



The opening ceremony of the 20th Asian Games in Japan’s Nagoya on Saturday, September 19, 2026. Photo: SF&OC.



There were a large number of empty seats at the 30,000-capacity stadium in Nagoya, where a subdued crowd saw a colourful opening ceremony on a heart-shaped stage.
